name: выход_из_боя
body:
! JO9 MOD START J9M2909 | 2026-10-10_restore_private_room_ui | changed block; context may be included if snk_room_target > 0 and $curloc = 'выход_из_боя': gs 'snk_room_bridge', 'guard', 'выход_из_боя' ! JO9 MOD END J9M2909 ! JO9 MOD START FOG_COMPANION_FINISH | 2026-10-17_fog_relay !CALCULATION OF COMBAT RESULTS ! JO9 MOD START TRAITS_COMBAT_WIN | 2026-10-17_traits_batch gs 'jo9_traits_combat', 'finish' ! JO9 MOD END TRAITS_COMBAT_WIN gs 'jo9_fog_relay', 'finish' ! JO9 MOD END FOG_COMPANION_FINISH !resume city sounds after the fight (if not at home) if is_home = 0: dynamic $city_sounds !for arena fight if $fight_return = 'Start': $fight_return = '' dynamic $master_energy_drop slave['energy'] = -3 if $итог_боя = 'убит': a = rand (1,6) if a > slave['stamina']: interaction_city = 1291 & gt 'interaction_city' slave_rate["wounds"] += rand(80,100) end if $итог_боя = 'бегство' or $итог_боя = 'вырубился' or $итог_боя = 'убит': slave['winning_series'] = 0 if slave['arena_level'] > 0: slave['arena_level'] -= 1 b = rand(0,3) gladiator_valor = slave['temper'] - slave['loser_rating'] if b > gladiator_valor: interaction_city = 1292 else interaction_city = 1293 slave_rate["wounds"] += rand(40,80) end end if $итог_боя = 'вырубился': slave['loser_rating'] += 100 end if $итог_боя = 'победа': slave['winning_series'] += 1 slave_rate["wounds"] += rand(11,25) interaction_city = 1294 if slave['arena_level'] < 5: slave['arena_level'] += 1 if slave['arena_level'] = 5: if slave['loser_rating'] = 0: interaction_city = 1295 else interaction_city = 1294 end else interaction_city = 1294 end end if slave['arena_level'] >= 5 and $slave['trademark_style'] = '': $slave['trademark_style'] = $g_type end gt 'interaction_city' end !Catfight Club if $fight_return = 'Start1': $fight_return = '' dynamic $master_energy_drop slave['energy'] = -3 if $итог_боя = 'убит': a = rand(1,6) if a > slave['stamina']: interaction_city = 103002 & gt 'interaction_city' end slave_rate["wounds"] += rand(80,100) end if $итог_боя = 'бегство' or $итог_боя = 'вырубился': slave['winning_series'] = 0 ! JO9 MOD START CATFIGHT_CUMULATIVE_LOSS | 2026-10-24_catfight_win_limit ! catfight_level은 누적 승수이므로 패배로 감소하지 않는다. ! JO9 MOD END CATFIGHT_CUMULATIVE_LOSS b = rand(0,3) gladiator_valor = slave['temper'] - slave['loser_rating'] if b > gladiator_valor: interaction_city = 103003 else interaction_city = 103004 slave_rate["wounds"] += rand(40,80) end if $итог_боя = 'вырубился': slave['loser_rating'] += 1 end $return_lock = 'goto_loc' gt 'interaction_city' end if $итог_боя = 'победа': slave['winning_series'] += 1 slave_rate["wounds"] += rand(11,25) interaction_city = 103005 ! JO9 MOD START CATFIGHT_SINGLE_WIN | 2026-10-24_catfight_win_limit ! 전투 종료에서만 승리당 한 번 가산한다. 기존 저장 승수는 역산하지 않는다. slave['catfight_level'] += 1 ! JO9 MOD START CATFIGHT_FAME_REWARD | 2026-10-24_contest_fame local jo9_catfight_fame = 0 if slave['catfight_level'] = 1: jo9_catfight_fame = 10 if slave['catfight_level'] = 2 or slave['catfight_level'] = 3: jo9_catfight_fame = 3 if slave_rate['fame'] < cont_atr_max: slave_rate['fame'] += min(jo9_catfight_fame, cont_atr_max - slave_rate['fame']) ! JO9 MOD END CATFIGHT_FAME_REWARD ! JO9 MOD END CATFIGHT_SINGLE_WIN $return_lock = 'goto_loc' gt 'interaction_city' end end !Increase master whip skill if used a whip (кнут) or lash (нагайка) for the battle as primary (оружие) or secondary (вторичный) weapon if combatant = 0 and ($оружие = 'кнут' or $оружие = 'нагайка' or $вторичный = 'кнут' or $вторичный = 'нагайка'): master_flagelation_rate += (skill_adv_mul * 1) !Sparring Practice if colosseum_fight > 0: if combatant = 0: dynamic $master_energy_drop interaction_city = 1296 end if combatant = 1: dynamic $slave_energy_drop interaction_city = 1297 end if combatant = 2: dynamic $assistant_energy_drop interaction_city = 1298 end copyarr '$display_options', '$colosseum_options' gs '_layout' gt 'interaction_city' !code lines below were never executed due to gt above, commented them out for clarity - ImperatorAugustus !combatant = 0 !colosseum_fight = 0 !$fight_return = '' !sp_txt = 1 !get_initial_slave = 0 !gt 'shop_general' end !slave battle misc if $враг[1] = 'воспитуемая': energy_max = slave['energy'] if выносливость_врага[1] < 5: slave['energy'] = -5 &! выносливость_врага is enemy stamina if выносливость_врага[1] >= 5: slave['energy'] = -4 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 10: slave['energy'] = -3 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 15: slave['energy'] = -2 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 20: slave['energy'] = -1 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 25: slave['energy'] = 0 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 35: slave['energy'] = 1 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 45: slave['energy'] = 2 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 55: slave['energy'] = 3 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 65: slave['energy'] = 4 if выносливость_врага[1] >= 75: slave['energy'] = 5 if slave['energy'] > energy_max: slave['energy'] = energy_max bash_damage_done = базовая_выносливость['воспитуемая'] - выносливость_врага[1] house_mess_rate += bash_damage_done slave_rate["hygiene"] += bash_damage_done master_hygiene_rate += bash_damage_done lethal_damage_done = базовое_здоровье['воспитуемая'] - здоровье_врага[1] if lethal_damage_done > 0: slave_rate["wounds"] += 10 if lethal_damage_done > базовое_здоровье['воспитуемая']/4: slave_rate["wounds"] += 10 if lethal_damage_done > базовое_здоровье['воспитуемая']/3: slave_rate["wounds"] += 20 if lethal_damage_done > базовое_здоровье['воспитуемая']/2: slave_rate["wounds"] += 40 if lethal_damage_done > базовое_здоровье['воспитуемая'] - 2: slave_rate["wounds"] += 80 if lethal_damage_done > slave["stamina"]: slave_rate["stamina"] -= 100000 psy_damage_done = базовый_дух['воспитуемая'] - дух_врага[1] slave_rate['mood'] -= min(25, psy_damage_done) &! reduced mood impact by half and capped at 2.5 - ImperatorAugustus pure_bashing_damage = bash_damage_done - lethal_damage_done if pure_bashing_damage < 0: pure_bashing_damage = 0 slave_rate['bruises'] += max(0, pure_bashing_damage - slave['stamina']*5) &! reduced bruising by half and added additional reduction proportional to endurance - ImperatorAugustus slave_rate['stamina'] -= max(0, pure_bashing_damage/10 - dynslave['stamina']) &! reduced and revised endurance impact - ImperatorAugustus end !additional results of the battle for the opponents if $итог_боя = 'бегство' and $враг[1] = 'воспитуемая': interaction_city = 143 gt "interaction_city" end if $итог_боя = 'вырубился' and $враг[1] = 'воспитуемая': dynamic $death, '당신은 노예의 주먹을 감당하지 못하고 무릎을 꿇었다. 그 모습을 본 노예는 미소를 지으며 다가와 발차기로 당신의 얼굴을 후려쳐 기절시켰다. 불행히도, 당신은 그 뒤 다시는 깨어나지 못했다…' end if $итог_боя = 'убит' and $враг[1] = 'воспитуемая': dynamic $death, '당신은 중상을 입고 피를 흘리며 바닥에 쓰러졌다. 마지막으로 본 것은 전직 노예가 거리로 뛰쳐나가는 모습뿐이었다…' end !general results if $итог_боя = 'бегство': dynamic $death, '당신은 겁을 먹고 전투에서 도망치려 했다. 실패했다.' end if $итог_боя = 'вырубился': ! JO9 MOD START J9M2908 | 2026-10-12_zzzz_gameover_layout | changed block; context may be included dynamic $death, '당신의 의식은 어둠 속으로 가라앉았다.
불멸의 로마에서, 당신의 이야기는 여기서 끝났다.' !
